title: Integer square root program body
statement: The program initializes the candidate variable to $0$ and the square variable to $1$. While the square variable is at most the argument, it replaces the square by the square plus twice the candidate plus $3$, then increases the candidate by $1$; when the loop ends, it assigns the candidate to the argument variable.
